Collaborative mindset and cultural adaptability to work with regional operations, product managers, and external merchant partners across diverse markets.
description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The DiDi Shop Merchant Growth Operations Intern will support merchant acquisition, activation, and growth initiatives for DiDi Shop, driving measurable improvements in merchant onboarding, order volume, and ASP performance. Their work will directly influence merchant supply density and quality across multiple countries. As part of the Merchant Growth team, the intern will help streamline operational workflows, analyze merchant performance metrics, and implement scalable playbooks that enable faster growth and an improved merchant experience.

In this role, you'll be...


Conduct data-driven merchant segmentation and cohort analyses to identify high-potential merchant profiles and report on KPIs such as new merchant activation rate, 7/30-day retention, and average GMV per merchant.
Design and execute A/B tests on onboarding flows, incentive structures, and marketing touchpoints to increase merchant activation by measurable percentages and present results with recommended rollouts.
Build and maintain dashboards and weekly performance reports that consolidate merchant acquisition, activation, and fulfillment metrics for regional managers and central growth leadership.
Draft and refine scalable onboarding playbooks, SOPs, and training materials for merchant-facing teams to improve consistency and shorten ramp time for new merchants.
Support cross-functional projects with product, payments, and risk teams to resolve operational friction points (e.g., verification, payment setup) and quantify impact on merchant activation and satisfaction.

description:
Buscamos Chief Marketing Officer | Especializado en Performance Marketing




En los últimos cuatro años multiplicamos por más de cinco el tamaño de PBG. Ahora vamos por algo más grande: convertirnos en lifestyle brand y llevar nuestra marca a Estados Unidos en un futuro cercano.




Quiénes somos

PBG es una compañía mexicana de menswear verticalmente integrada. Diseñamos, fabricamos en talleres propios y entregamos prendas a la medida en una semana. Tenemos dos marcas:




Morera Grosso, lujo, en expansión a nuevas plazas.
Havoc, premium, con tiendas en todo el país y un e-commerce recién relanzado.
Nuestro NPS supera al mejor referente de venta directa en México.




Hacia dónde vamos

Pasar de tailor shop a lifestyle brand, con nuevas categorías y un ready-to-wear en expansión.
Convertir el e-commerce relanzado en un motor de crecimiento.
Seguir expandiendonos en México y preparar nuestra llegada a mercados internacionales.




El rol

Posición de nueva creación en el equipo directivo, con reporte al CEO. Serás dueño de la marca y de la demanda de ambas marcas, en México y en EE.UU., con el presupuesto completo de brand y performance. Aquí la voz de la marca se decide adentro: la estrategia de comunicación es tuya, y tú decides qué se produce en casa y qué con socios externos.




Tu misión

Ser dueño de la estrategia de comunicación: qué dice cada marca, a quién y en qué tono, sobre la plataforma de marca que estamos construyendo en este momento.
Co-liderar con la dirección de producto la evolución a lifestyle brand, activando las categorías nuevas con campañas y contenido.
Dirigir la generación de demanda (paid, e-commerce marketing, CRM y retención) con metas de negocio (citas y ventas en tienda) y definir la mezcla de inversión entre marca y performance, defendida con medición de incrementalidad.
Llevar el e-commerce relanzado a canal rentable y en crecimiento.
Dirigir y escalar un equipo de especialistas fuertes (brand, growth, e-commerce, retención).
Preparar el capítulo internacional de la compañía, con la construcción de la marca y del motor de demanda desde el día uno.




Lo que buscamos

10 a 15 años en marketing, 5 o más como Director, VP o CMO.
Experiencia comprobable en marca y en performance, con inversión de siete cifras mensuales.
Negocios con venta en tienda física y categorías donde el margen importa.
Haber lanzado marcas, categorías o mercados; EE.UU. es un gran plus.
Inglés de negocios fluido. Deseable: moda o lifestyle premium.




Qué ofrecemos

Paquete ejecutivo competitivo (base, bono anual por resultados e incentivos de largo plazo) y la oportunidad de construir el marketing de una compañía en su mejor momento.




📍 Lugar de trabajo: Ciudad de México, modalidad presencial. Al inicio en la colonia Las Granjas, en Iztacalco, con oficinas en transición hacia Polanco, Lomas Altas o Lomas de Chapultepec en el mediano o largo plazo




Cómo postularte: envía tu CV, un caso de construcción de demanda contado con números y una campaña que hayas conceptualizado a Mariela Hernandez Perales <mariela.hernandez@pbgroup.mx>




¿Conoces a alguien con este perfil? Etiquétalo o comparte.




#CMO #Marketing #Vacante #Menswear #Moda #CDMX #Ecommerce #Retail

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Marketing Manager

Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

Our clients include Fortune 500 enterprises, fast-growing startups backed by Sequoia, Founders Fund, and Andreessen Horowitz, and high-performing companies of every size in between. We offer roles in project management, operations, finance, design, marketing, customer success, and more. Every hire is for a specific open position: one person, one dedicated client, built to last.




Every offer we make is for an open role with a single client — the kind of role that’s almost impossible to find on your own: industry-leading pay set against your experience and skill, real career growth, and a stable seat at a serious company, working from home, anywhere in the world.




Persona was founded in 2018 by two Stanford graduates on a simple idea: talent is everywhere, but opportunity isn’t. By recruiting globally for specific client roles, we’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing companies in the global staffing industry. Every applicant goes through the same steps, and each one is designed to let you show what you can actually do.




We hire people who care about the craft of their work, take ownership without being asked, and want to build a career rather than just hold a job. If that’s you, and one of our open roles fits, we’d like to meet you.




Role Summary

We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success & Digital Marketing Manager to support the growth and customer experience of an AI-powered donor research and prospecting tool serving nonprofit organizations, development directors, grant writers, and consultants.




This role combines hands-on customer success with digital marketing ownership. You will serve as the primary point of contact for users, guide new customers through their free trials, help convert trial users into paying subscribers, and support customer retention through responsive communication and ongoing engagement.




You will also own the tool's marketing plan, manage Google Search advertising, monitor search and AI-driven visibility, and coordinate marketing initiatives across internal and external partners. The ideal candidate combines strong customer communication skills with practical digital marketing experience and a data-driven approach to improving signups, conversions, and customer satisfaction.




This is a remote position focused on candidates based in Latin America.




Key Responsibilities

Customer Success & User Support

Serve as the primary human point of contact for users of the AI-powered donor research and prospecting platform.
Respond promptly and professionally to customer emails, calls, and website inquiries, including "Talk to us" requests.
Welcome new trial users and help them get started through onboarding emails, short instructional guides, and videos.
Proactively engage users during their 30-day free trial to answer questions, encourage product adoption, and support conversion to paid subscription plans.
Handle billing inquiries, subscription plan changes, and cancellation requests.
Gather cancellation reasons and customer feedback to identify opportunities to improve retention and the overall customer experience.
Collect and organize product feedback, feature requests, and user-reported issues for internal review.
Maintain accurate, helpful customer-facing resources, including the help page and frequently asked questions.
Manage the customer referral program and coordinate referral incentives.
Encourage satisfied customers to share reviews on G2 and Capterra and participate in customer testimonials or success stories.

Digital Marketing & Customer Acquisition

Own and execute the marketing plan for the software platform, focusing on customer acquisition, trial signups, and paid conversions.
Set up, manage, test, and optimize Google Search advertising campaigns within established budgets.
Monitor campaign performance and prioritize advertising strategies that generate qualified signups.
Track search engine optimization (SEO) performance, including Google search rankings and organic visibility.
Monitor generative engine optimization (GEO), including the platform's visibility and mentions in AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT.
Manage and maintain the platform's profiles on G2, Capterra, Crunchbase, and Google Business Profile.
Support company leadership in drafting monthly LinkedIn articles and related thought-leadership content.
Prepare and distribute a concise monthly email or newsletter to customers and trial users.
Coordinate website content and demo video updates as new platform features become available.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing messaging, product awareness, and the customer signup journey.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

Monitor key customer and marketing metrics, including trial signups, free-to-paid conversions, customer engagement, and cancellations.
Use Google Analytics and advertising performance data to assess customer acquisition and marketing effectiveness.
Evaluate Google Ads results, identify effective campaigns, and recommend improvements based on performance.
Track changes in SEO rankings and AI-powered search visibility.
Prepare monthly marketing performance reports for company leadership.
Communicate customer feedback, recurring issues, marketing insights, and opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional & External Partner Coordination

Maintain clear, consistent communication with the external marketing agency regarding marketing initiatives, campaign execution, and performance.
Coordinate with the software development and maintenance partner on customer-reported issues, feature updates, and technical matters.
Work closely with internal stakeholders to align customer experience, marketing priorities, and product improvements.
Follow up on customer issues and requested enhancements to ensure appropriate internal coordination.
Keep relevant stakeholders informed of customer needs, campaign progress, and product-related updates.




Required Qualifications

Experience in customer success, account management, or digital marketing, ideally supporting a software product or subscription-based platform.
Hands-on experience setting up, managing, and optimizing Google Ads campaigns, particularly Google Search advertising.
Comfortable using Google Analytics, interpreting marketing performance data, and reviewing monthly metrics.
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, friendly customer emails, onboarding guides, marketing content, and reports.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers through email, calls, and other support channels.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage customer support requests, marketing initiatives, and reporting responsibilities simultaneously.
Ability to interpret campaign and customer performance metrics and use findings to inform practical improvements.
Strong attention to detail when managing subscriptions, customer communications, platform information, and marketing activities.
Ability to coordinate professionally with internal teams, external marketing partners, and software development stakeholders.
Proactive, independent working style with the ability to follow through on customer issues and marketing priorities.
Ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
Must be based in Latin America.




Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting a SaaS product, self-service software platform, or subscription-based digital service.
Experience onboarding free-trial users and improving trial-to-paid conversion rates.
Familiarity with customer retention, subscription management, cancellation analysis, and referral programs.
Experience developing or maintaining customer help centers, FAQs, onboarding materials, or short tutorial videos.
Knowledge of SEO principles and monitoring organic search performance.
Familiarity with GEO and tracking brand or product visibility in AI-powered search and conversational tools.
Experience managing company profiles and customer reviews on G2, Capterra, Crunchbase, or Google Business Profile.
Experience drafting newsletters, customer lifecycle emails, or LinkedIn thought-leadership content.
Experience collaborating with external marketing agencies and software development partners.
Familiarity with nonprofit organizations, fundraising, donor prospecting, or grant research.




Tools & Technologies

Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search, SEO tracking tools, AI-powered search tools such as ChatGPT, G2, Capterra, Crunchbase, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, email and newsletter platforms, website content management tools, customer communication tools, help center and FAQ systems, subscription management platforms, customer feedback and issue-tracking tools.




Core Competencies

Customer-focused communication
Customer onboarding and retention
Digital marketing and Google Ads management
Data analysis and performance tracking
Clear and effective writing
Proactive problem-solving
Cross-functional collaboration
Organization and time management
Ownership and accountability
Adaptability and technical proficiency




What We Offer

Best salaries in the industry
work remotely from the location specified for this role permanently
Opportunities for growth and advancement
A fast-paced and collaborative environment
A warm, people-first company culture
Get paid in your currency of choice
Full benefits

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Acerca de WPP Media

WPP es la empresa de transformación creativa. Aprovechamos el poder de la creatividad para construir un futuro mejor para nuestra gente, el planeta, nuestros clientes y nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información, visita wpp.com.

WPP Media es el colectivo global de medios de WPP. En un mundo donde los medios están en todas partes y en todo, reunimos las mejores plataformas, personas y socios para crear oportunidades ilimitadas de crecimiento. Para obtener más información, visita wppmedia.com

En WPP Media, creemos en el poder de nuestra cultura y de nuestra gente. Es lo que nos impulsa a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales tanto a nuestros clientes como entre nosotros. En este puesto, será fundamental adoptar los valores fundamentales compartidos por WPP y WPP Media:


Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Crear un ambiente abierto equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y de los clientes mediante el fomento de la confianza.
Liderar con optimismo promoviendo el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a la empresa.


Responsabilidades

Habilidades y Experiencia

Office Avanzado, especialmente Excel (tablas dinámicas, cruces de bases y análisis de data) y PowerPoint para presentaciones ejecutivas.


Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de tres días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Agradecemos a todas las personas que se postulen a esta vacante; sin embargo, solo contactaremos a los candidatos seleccionados para una entrevista.

title: Creador/a de Contenido y Community Manager de TikTok
description:
En Gamol buscamos Creador/a de Contenido y Community Manager de TikTok para Wingstop México.




Ciudad de México | $10,000 a $12,000 MXN mensuales




Buscamos una persona de tiempo completo. También consideramos contratación por cuenta para llevar el TikTok de Wingstop México.




Si alguien comenta «¿cuál salsa pica de verdad?», ¿cómo le contestarías en un TikTok de 20 segundos? Buscamos a alguien que pueda escribir la idea, ir a sucursal, grabar la prueba y editar una respuesta que la gente quiera ver y compartir.




Tu principal responsabilidad será producir contenido para la cuenta. Trabajarás con nuestro equipo de influencers para publicar 15 TikToks al mes. La mezcla inicial contempla ocho piezas de tendencias, humor o respuestas en video, cuatro grabadas por ti en sucursales y tres colaboraciones con creadores.




Qué harás




• Detectar conversaciones de comida, deportes y cultura pop, y proponer una idea mientras la tendencia siga vigente.
• Grabar en sucursales y eventos de CDMX. Dirigir a quienes participen, aparecer a cuadro o poner voz cuando la historia lo pida.
• Editar video vertical con buen ritmo, subtítulos y audio limpio. Crear piezas con voz en off, animación sencilla y herramientas de IA cuando aporten a la idea.
• Responder con la voz del Tío Wingstop. Saber cuándo un comentario merece un video y cuándo un cliente necesita atención en privado y seguimiento a su pedido.
• Llevar las piezas hasta su aprobación y publicación. Revisar la retención, los compartidos y el crecimiento orgánico para decidir qué repetir o cambiar.




Qué necesitas




• Vivir en Ciudad de México y poder acudir personalmente a grabaciones. Ambos requisitos son indispensables.
• Haber manejado una cuenta grande de TikTok y poder demostrar su tamaño, tus responsabilidades y los resultados obtenidos.
• Haber sostenido un volumen cercano a 15 videos mensuales y poder explicar cuántos produjiste personalmente.
• Saber grabar y editar una pieza de principio a fin. Valoramos experiencia en restaurantes, entretenimiento, deportes o colaboraciones con influencers.




Cómo postularte




Compártenos por LinkedIn tu CV o portafolio y tres TikToks publicados. Cuéntanos qué hiciste tú en cada uno e incluye al menos uno que hayas grabado y editado personalmente. De una cuenta que hayas manejado, indica el periodo, el tamaño de la audiencia, cuántos videos producías al mes y un resultado concreto. Si hubo pauta, acláralo. Confirma también tu disponibilidad para grabar en CDMX.




Las personas finalistas realizarán una prueba práctica breve y pagada.

description:
Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right. Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Engineer to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Engineer?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Engineer role combines brand strategy, copywriting, and AI to create marketing work for our clients. You know each client’s brand inside out and use AI tools to turn a brief into strong, on-brand work quickly. You’re paired with an Account Manager, who owns the client relationship, and you work with our designers, developers, and video team to achieve the best output for the client.




Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on experience with the following:

Copywriting with a sharp sense of brand and tone of voice. Strong, on-brand copy is the foundation of every piece of work.
AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney, Gemini, etc. You know their strengths, how to get great output from them, and when to use which tool.
Claude for creating copy, social posts, ads, presentations, landing pages, and websites.
Figma for designs and website layouts.
Canva for social posts, ads, and quick graphics from each client’s brand kit.
Webflow and WordPress for building and updating client websites.




*If you’re not already hands-on with Figma, Canva, and Webflow, you need to be quick to learn them.




About You




A marketer first: you start with the goal, then figure out the strategy, the design, and the words
Comfortable working with AI every day, and curious about pushing it further; you don’t accept the first output as the final product
Has at least a professional level of written and spoken English
A strong eye for design, able to lead creative direction even when you’re not the one designing
A strong writer who knows how to adapt tone to any brand across platforms and contexts
A clear, confident communicator with your Account Manager, the Creative Hub, and clients
Organized and fast, able to move several clients’ work forward at once
You take ownership and use good judgement without waiting to be told




Main Objectives




1. Brand Ownership

Own each client’s brand system, making sure every client has an up-to-date design system set up in Claude that anyone at D&Z can use
Keep each brand consistent across everything a client receives




2. Hands-On Production

Take the lead on copy that sounds like the brand and moves people to act
Use AI tools every day to research, write, design, and build faster without losing quality, so clients ask for fewer changes




3. Internal Collaboration

Bring in the Creative Hub when the work needs more detail than the first draft can produce, such as refining a design, editing video, creating custom illustrations, building complex website features, or running paid media. Make your requests clear and easy to act on.
Share what works by passing useful prompts, workflows, and ideas to the other Brand Engineers.




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Understand each client’s business and goals, and build the roadmap to get there
Lead the creative direction on campaigns, social, ads, landing pages, and websites
Work with clients directly: present ideas, explain your thinking, and build their confidence in the work
Use your judgement on when Claude or another AI tool can’t produce what a client needs, and keep projects moving from brief to client quickly




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

The role requires strong campaign management, analytical, project-management, and stakeholder-management capabilities, along with the ability to coordinate concurrent initiatives across global teams.

You will work closely with global Sales, Product Marketing, Editorial, Digital, and Events teams to build, activate, and measure omnichannel campaigns that strengthen engagement, generate qualified demand, and contribute to commercial goals.

description:
Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

Account Growth & Commercial Development

Drive day-to-day commercial growth across assigned accounts by identifying upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities. Support account growth plans, maintain opportunity visibility, and contribute to revenue, retention, and renewal targets.

Client Relationship Management

Serve as the primary day-to-day commercial contact for assigned clients. Build trusted relationships, understand client goals and priorities, and expand stakeholder engagement across business, ecommerce, marketing, IT, operations, and leadership teams.

Account Health & Retention

Monitor account health, client satisfaction, delivery performance, budget alignment, and future growth potential. Identify risks early, elevate with clear recommendations, and support renewal planning to protect and grow recurring revenue.

Strategic Execution

Execute the account strategy and ways of working defined with the Account Director. Turn account plans into practical actions, including client meetings, follow-ups, opportunity tracking, roadmap discussions, and commercial next steps.

Internal Coordination & Delivery Alignment

Work closely with delivery, strategy, design, data, AI, content, and technical teams to ensure client needs are understood and acted on. Keep internal teams aligned to client expectations, commercial commitments, and growth priorities.

Reporting & Performance Management

Maintain accurate account records, stakeholder maps, opportunity updates, renewal dates, and commercial activity. Use KPIs and account data to provide clear updates on performance, risks, pipeline, and next steps.

Solid understanding of digital commerce, digital experience, ecommerce platforms, content management, data, AI, integrations, and modern technology delivery concepts.

Strong ability to recognize client needs, uncover growth opportunities, and connect those opportunities to relevant services or solutions.

Comfortable discussing budgets, renewals, scope, value, commercial priorities, and business outcomes with clients and internal stakeholders.

Relationship Management

Strong ability to build trust with client stakeholders and internal teams.

Confident managing day-to-day client communication, expectation setting, follow-ups, and issue resolution.

Able to develop relationships across multiple stakeholder groups within an account.

Organization & Execution

Highly organized and able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, meetings, follow-ups, and commercial activities at the same time.

Strong attention to detail, with the ability to keep account plans, opportunity tracking, renewals, and client communications moving forward.

Data & Performance Orientation

Comfortable using KPIs, client health indicators, performance data, CRM information, and account reporting to guide decisions.

Able to identify patterns, risks, and growth opportunities based on account data and client behavior.

Communication

Exceptional English and Spanish proficiency; ability to build rapport and manage expectations effectively.

Growth-Minded

Personality Traits:

Proactively looks for ways to create more value for clients and expand Vaimo’s role within the account.

Commercially Curious

Asks strong questions, listens for business needs, and connects client challenges to potential opportunities.

Proactive Communicator

Keeps clients, Account Directors, and internal teams informed of opportunities, risks, decisions, and required actions.

Reliable Executor

Follows through consistently, manages details carefully, and ensures account activity does not lose momentum.

Collaborative

Works well across strategy, delivery, technology, design, data, AI, content, and commercial teams to create better client outcomes.

Relationship-Oriented

Naturally builds trust with clients and internal team members and understands that strong relationships are the foundation for retention and growth.

We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for an organized, customer-obsessed, and highly motivated individual to join our Support Team in our Mexico City office. This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world’s top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. In this role, you will be responsible for providing our customers with consistently high-quality customer support and product education. You will respond to, research, reproduce, and resolve questions and issues related to our customers’ usage of the Watershed platform, while also serving as a customer advocate by providing internal feedback to inform product improvements and new features.

You will:


Assist customers in solving problems related to product features, platform usability, technical issues, product performance, and time-sensitive inquiries. 
Exceed client expectations on response quality, timeliness of responses, and overall customer experience.

Educate customers on usage of our platform and advocate for customer needs internally — with a goal of continually improving the customer experience. 
Be empowered to think independently, creatively, and critically — going above and beyond to deliver the right solution for each individual customer. 
Liaise with team members across the Watershed ecosystem (Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success, Sustainability Services, and more) to drive positive outcomes for every customer. 
Explain the technical details of carbon accounting and emissions measurement methodology — and how it applies to an individual customer’s business operations. 


You might be a fit if you:


Have 1-2 years in a B2B/SaaS customer support environment. 
Have a strong sense of customer empathy, always remaining laser-focused on the customer’s needs. 
Have experience using support ticketing software, Notion, and Linear (or similar). 
Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can readily explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 
Have strong interpersonal skills, allowing you to function within a team and to build relationships with customers and other stakeholders across Watershed. 
Are organized, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume, evolving environment with a proven ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time autonomously. 
Are solution-driven and won't rest until you uncover the root cause of an issue. 
Are curious, and enjoy learning new things. You’re excited by the challenge of learning more about the sustainability space. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

In this role, you’d be joining the Professional Services team. Our team’s mission is to empower every Stripe user to achieve maximum value from their investment quickly and confidently. Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by supporting the success of our large, intricate Stripe implementations. This involves guiding users through their integration process, project planning, coordinating with stakeholders, handling deliverables, meeting key timelines, and educating our users about the maximum potential they can achieve with Stripe.

As an Implementation Consultant at Stripe, you are the driving force behind these strategic implementations. Your role is key in leading them through the integration process, turning them into long-term transacting Stripe users. Our team’s core objective is to provide an efficient, seamless transition for our clients, assuring top-notch user satisfaction and relationship management.

What you’ll do

As an Implementation Consultant, you will be managing the full onboarding cycle for mid-market and enterprise companies from contract signing through launch. You will proactively develop and manage integration architecture, change management strategy, and timelines. You will be expected to collaborate across departments, including Sales, Technical Services, Product, and Engineering, to ensure a successful transition for our clients.

Responsibilities


Own the full onboarding cycle for mid-market and enterprise companies from contract signing through launch.
Develop, manage, and implement a customer’s integration architecture, change management strategy, and timeline.
Partner with other Sales and Technical Services teams to improve the overall Stripe user journey.
Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy for large users.
Collaborate with teammates on strategic projects that improve and scale our implementation process and team operations.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


4+ years of experience working with strategic customers on technology solutions, with a track record of top performance
Ability to understand complex business requirements and craft tailored solutions
Quick learner with the ability to explain technical concepts to Stripe’s largest customers
Proven project management skills and strong critical thinking abilities
Experience identifying and solving internal process inefficiencies
Superior verbal and written communication skills
Ability to operate independently in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company
Experience in the payments industry
Knowledge of APIs
Knowledge of SQL



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Para conocer más: https://plc.pearson.com

Esta posición tendrá un rol clave en la operación de evaluaciones de alto volumen para clientes estratégicos en México, apoyando la coordinación logística, administrativa y operativa necesaria para entregar miles de exámenes cada año en diferentes sedes.





Sobre la posición:





Estamos buscando una persona para integrarse al equipo de Customer Success en México. En esta posición, serás responsable de brindar soporte logístico y administrativo para la operación de evaluaciones de inglés, ayudando a coordinar la ejecución de exámenes en distintas regiones y sedes, con foco en asegurar que los compromisos con clientes clave se cumplan de forma organizada y oportuna.





La posición combina actividades administrativas, coordinación operativa, manejo de información, comunicación con estudiantes y stakeholders internos, y soporte en la preparación física y digital de materiales para sesiones de evaluación. Es una oportunidad ideal para alguien altamente organizado, detallista, con buena comunicación interna y motivación por crecer dentro de un equipo vinculado a educación, assessment y customer success.





La persona debe estar basada en Ciudad de México o en una zona del Estado de México con acceso viable a Polanco, ya que será necesario asistir de forma híbrida al espacio de trabajo en Polanco en algunos momentos del mes, especialmente durante periodos de mayor actividad operativa.





Responsabilidades principales:




Apoyar la coordinación diaria de evaluaciones de inglés, ayudando con la organización de fechas, sedes, materiales y listas de participantes.



Mantener actualizados archivos, bases de datos y documentos operativos en herramientas como Excel y SharePoint.



Preparar y enviar comunicaciones simples a estudiantes y contactos internos, incluyendo instrucciones, horarios y seguimiento de consultas.



Apoyar la preparación y organización de materiales físicos o digitales necesarios para las sesiones de examen.



Colaborar con el equipo para asegurar que la operación avance de forma ordenada y que la información esté correcta y disponible cuando se necesite.




Habilidades y experiencia requeridas:




Buena organización, atención al detalle y ganas de aprender.



Manejo básico o intermedio de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y Word.



Interés en tareas administrativas, coordinación operativa, atención a clientes o educación.



Comunicación clara y actitud de servicio para apoyar a estudiantes, clientes y equipos internos.

title: Account Manager
description:
Vaimo

is one of the world’s most respected

experts in digital commerce and experience . As a full-service omnichannel partner,

we deliver strategy, design, development

and managed services to brands, retailers and manufacturers all over the world.

As an

Account Manager at Vaimo , you are responsible for driving day-to-day client growth, account health, and commercial success across a designated portfolio of clients.

Working closely

with the Account Director, you will help execute account strategies that deepen client relationships, increase client value, improve retention, and identify new opportunities for growth. You are the primary day-to-day commercial partner for your clients, ensuring that Vaimo remains closely aligned with their business priorities, digital roadmap, and evolving needs.

This role requires a

strong balance of relationship management, commercial awareness, operational follow-through, and understanding of digital commerce, experience, data, AI, content, and technology services . You will act as a connector between client stakeholders and Vaimo’s internal teams, helping turn client needs into actionable growth opportunities and successful delivery outcomes.

Areas Of Responsibility

Account Growth & Commercial Development

Drive day-to-day commercial growth across assigned accounts by identifying upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities. Support account growth plans, maintain opportunity visibility, and contribute to revenue, retention, and renewal targets.

Client Relationship Management

Serve as the primary day-to-day commercial contact for assigned clients. Build trusted relationships, understand client goals and priorities, and expand stakeholder engagement across business, ecommerce, marketing, IT, operations, and leadership teams.

Account Health & Retention

Monitor account health, client satisfaction, delivery performance, budget alignment, and future growth potential. Identify risks early, elevate with clear recommendations, and support renewal planning to protect and grow recurring revenue.

Strategic Execution

Execute the account strategy and ways of working defined with the Account Director. Turn account plans into practical actions, including client meetings, follow-ups, opportunity tracking, roadmap discussions, and commercial next steps.

Internal Coordination & Delivery Alignment

Work closely with delivery, strategy, design, data, AI, content, and technical teams to ensure client needs are understood and acted on. Keep internal teams aligned to client expectations, commercial commitments, and growth priorities.

Reporting & Performance Management

Maintain accurate account records, stakeholder maps, opportunity updates, renewal dates, and commercial activity. Use KPIs and account data to provide clear updates on performance, risks, pipeline, and next steps.

Experience

What We’re Looking For:

3–5 years of experience in Account Management, Client Success, Business Development, or Commercial Account Growth, ideally within a digital agency, technology consulting, ecommerce, SaaS, or professional services environment.

Digital & Technical Literacy

Solid understanding of digital commerce, digital experience, ecommerce platforms, content management, data, AI, integrations, and modern technology delivery concepts.

Ability to translate client business needs into clear internal briefs and explain technical or digital concepts in a practical, client-friendly way.

Commercial Acumen

Strong ability to recognize client needs, uncover growth opportunities, and connect those opportunities to relevant services or solutions.

Comfortable discussing budgets, renewals, scope, value, commercial priorities, and business outcomes with clients and internal stakeholders.

Relationship Management

Strong ability to build trust with client stakeholders and internal teams.

Confident managing day-to-day client communication, expectation setting, follow-ups, and issue resolution.

Able to develop relationships across multiple stakeholder groups within an account.

Organization & Execution

Highly organized and able to manage multiple accounts, priorities, meetings, follow-ups, and commercial activities at the same time.

Strong attention to detail, with the ability to keep account plans, opportunity tracking, renewals, and client communications moving forward.

Data & Performance Orientation

Comfortable using KPIs, client health indicators, performance data, CRM information, and account reporting to guide decisions.

Able to identify patterns, risks, and growth opportunities based on account data and client behavior.

Communication

Exceptional English and Spanish proficiency; ability to build rapport and manage expectations effectively.

Growth-Minded

Personality Traits:

Proactively looks for ways to create more value for clients and expand Vaimo’s role within the account.

Commercially Curious

Asks strong questions, listens for business needs, and connects client challenges to potential opportunities.

Proactive Communicator

Keeps clients, Account Directors, and internal teams informed of opportunities, risks, decisions, and required actions.

Reliable Executor

Follows through consistently, manages details carefully, and ensures account activity does not lose momentum.

Collaborative

Works well across strategy, delivery, technology, design, data, AI, content, and commercial teams to create better client outcomes.

Relationship-Oriented

Naturally builds trust with clients and internal team members and understands that strong relationships are the foundation for retention and growth.

We Offer You

Work with leading US brands:

Help brands, retailers, manufacturers, and institutions grow by connecting commerce, content, data, and activation to create better digital experiences.

International Collaboration

Work directly with clients and experienced colleagues in the US and across Vaimo's international teams.

AI In Everyday Work

Use AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and deliver better results.

Ownership And Autonomy

Take responsibility for your work, contribute ideas, and influence how projects are delivered.

Professional Growth

title: Analista SEO
description:
Objetivo del Puesto

Planificar, ejecutar y optimizar la estrategia de posicionamiento orgánico (SEO) de los activos digitales de la empresa para incrementar la visibilidad en motores de búsqueda, aumentar el tráfico de calidad, mejorar la generación de leads y contribuir al cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales mediante estrategias técnicas, de contenido y analíticas. Buscamos un profesional analítico, orientado a resultados y con visión estratégica, capaz de transformar datos en oportunidades de crecimiento orgánico. Deberá mantenerse actualizado sobre las tendencias de SEO, los cambios en los algoritmos de los motores de búsqueda y la evolución de las búsquedas impulsadas por inteligencia artificial, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinarios para maximizar el rendimiento de los activos digitales y contribuir al crecimiento del negocio.




Estrategia SEO

Diseñar e implementar la estrategia de SEO On-Page, Off-Page y SEO Técnico. Realizar investigaciones de palabras clave (Keyword Research) alineadas con los objetivos de negocio. Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento orgánico y posicionamiento frente a la competencia. Elaborar roadmaps y planes de optimización continua.




Optimización de sitios web

Optimizar títulos, metadescripciones, encabezados, URLs y arquitectura del sitio. Supervisar la correcta indexación y rastreo del sitio web. Detectar y corregir errores técnicos que afecten el posicionamiento. Mejorar la velocidad de carga, experiencia de usuario (UX) y rendimiento web en coordinación con el equipo de desarrollo. Implementar estrategias de enlazado interno.




Estrategia de contenido

Definir estrategias de contenido basadas en intención de búsqueda. Colaborar con Copywriters y Content Managers para desarrollar contenido optimizado. Optimizar contenido existente para mejorar su posicionamiento. Analizar tendencias de búsqueda y oportunidades de contenido.




Analítica y monitoreo

Monitorear el desempeño del posicionamiento orgánico. Elaborar reportes ejecutivos con resultados, tendencias y recomendaciones. Analizar tráfico, conversiones y comportamiento de los usuarios. Dar seguimiento a las actualizaciones de algoritmos de los motores de búsqueda.




Competencia y mercado

Analizar estrategias SEO de competidores. Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento frente al mercado. Monitorear tendencias y mejores prácticas del ecosistema digital.




Habilidades Técnicas

SEO Técnico. SEO On-Page. SEO Off-Page. Keyword Research. Link Building. Arquitectura web. Optimización de velocidad (Core Web Vitals). Analítica digital. Interpretación de datos. Redacción SEO.




Herramientas

Google Analytics (GA4) Google Search Console Google Tag Manager Looker Studio Semrush o Ahrefs Screaming Frog SEO Spider PageSpeed Insights Microsoft Excel o Google Sheets (nivel intermedio-avanzado).




Competencias personales

Pensamiento analítico. Orientación a resultados. Organización. Atención al detalle. Capacidad de investigación. Resolución de problemas. Comunicación efectiva. Aprendizaje continuo. Trabajo colaborativo. Adaptabilidad y manejo de tiempos de entrega.




Requisitos

Licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Informática, Negocios Digitales o carrera afín. 2 a 4 años de experiencia en estrategias SEO. Experiencia optimizando sitios web con enfoque comercial. Conocimiento de plataformas CMS como WordPress. Experiencia trabajando con equipos de contenido y desarrollo web. Conocimientos deseables HTML y CSS básico. JavaScript básico para interpretación de implementaciones. SEO Local. SEO para eCommerce. Optimización para IA generativa y motores de búsqueda con inteligencia artificial (AEO/Generative Engine Optimization). CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization). Uso de herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para investigación, generación y optimización de contenido.




Objetivos y KPIs

Crecimiento del tráfico orgánico 

Incrementar visitas provenientes de buscadores. 

Posicionamiento de palabras clave 

Aumentar el número de keywords en Top 3, Top 10 y Top 20. 

Leads generados por tráfico orgánico Incrementar conversiones provenientes de SEO. 

Visibilidad orgánica 

Mejorar la presencia de la marca en motores de búsqueda. 

CTR orgánico 

Incrementar la tasa de clics desde los resultados de búsqueda. 

Core Web Vitals 

Mantener indicadores dentro de los estándares recomendados. 

Errores técnicos SEO 

Reducir problemas de indexación, enlaces rotos y contenido duplicado. 

Tiempo de indexación de nuevas páginas 

Disminuir el tiempo entre publicación e indexación. 

Autoridad del dominio y perfil de backlinks 

Incrementar la calidad y cantidad de enlaces relevantes. 

ROI de las estrategias SEO 

Medir el impacto del posicionamiento orgánico sobre los objetivos comerciales. 

Cumplimiento del plan de optimización 

Ejecutar las iniciativas SEO dentro de los tiempos establecidos.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. description:
About The Team

DoorDash's Retention Marketing team creates lifecycle communications that help Dashers and merchants stay informed, engaged, and successful on our platform. We combine hands-on customer relationship management (CRM) execution with audience insights to deliver relevant email, push, SMS, and in-app campaigns. Our focus is reliable campaign delivery, operational efficiency, and measurable retention impact.

About The Role

As a Senior Associate, Retention Marketing, you will be an individual contributor spending approximately 70–80% of your time building, testing, and launching lifecycle campaigns and 20–30% on strategy and stakeholder collaboration, with success measured by campaign quality, on-time delivery, production efficiency, and lifecycle effectiveness. You will execute campaigns in Beacon, our current platform, applying experience from comparable CRM tools to support Dasher or merchant lifecycle programs. This role is based in Mexico City with one office day per week, typically Thursday, and flexibility to collaborate across US time zones. You will report into a Retention Marketing Manager on our Retention Marketing team in our Growth Marketing organization.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Build, test, and launch campaigns across email, push, SMS, and in-app messaging, owning audience setup, personalization, scheduling, and deployment.
Configure automated journeys, including triggers, decision splits, entry and exit criteria, and exclusion rules that ensure messages reach eligible audiences.
Validate campaign content, audience eligibility, personalization, links, timing, and automation logic, resolving execution issues before and after launch.
Partner with US-based marketing, data, product, engineering, and design teams to clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and communicate campaign progress and risks.
Use delivery, engagement, and quality metrics to recommend lifecycle improvements and strengthen testing, documentation, and production workflows.


We're excited about you because…


You have 3+ years of experience in CRM operations, lifecycle marketing, retention marketing, email marketing, or marketing automation, including at least two recent years of substantial hands-on campaign execution.
You have personally built, tested, and launched campaigns in a scaled CRM or marketing automation platform, such as Iterable, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze, or a comparable tool.
You can configure audience segments, automated journeys, and personalization for campaigns reaching 100,000+ users or for business audiences with complex lifecycle requirements.
You can validate campaign setup, troubleshoot execution issues, and interpret campaign data to improve quality and effectiveness.
You can independently manage multiple campaign deadlines and dependencies while communicating clearly in written and spoken English with US-based partners.


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Marketing Analyst | Channel Partner B2B
description:
Skeelo Ciudad de México, Ciudad de México, Mexico

Skeelo es una plataforma digital de lectura que conecta a las personas con e-books, audiolibros y minibooks en una experiencia accesible y personalizada. Desde 2019, utilizamos la tecnología como un medio para democratizar el acceso a la lectura y ampliar su impacto en el desarrollo de las personas.

Creemos que leer va más allá del ocio: es una herramienta poderosa para ampliar horizontes, fortalecer el pensamiento crítico e impulsar el desarrollo humano.

Estamos distribuidos y distribuidas en Brasil y en el mundo, impulsados por la innovación, la agilidad y el aprendizaje continuo, valorando la diversidad y transformando la lectura para adaptarla a la vida de las personas. Hacemos todo esto con transparencia en las relaciones, valentía para innovar, enfoque en alta performance, mirada constante en encantar a clientes y lectores, y entregas ágiles que marcan la diferencia.

Nuestro modelo de trabajo es remote first, aprovechando lo mejor del home office: autorresponsabilidad con autonomía. Sin embargo, también creemos en la conexión y en el intercambio que generan los encuentros presenciales; por eso, realizamos algunos encuentros en São Paulo – SP para fortalecer la conexión con los demás Skeelers. Pero tranquila/o, Skeelo siempre organiza todo por nosotros.

¡El equipo de Marketing necesita a alguien y queremos que seas parte de nuestro equipo!

¿Tu misión? Garantizar la excelencia operativa y el desempeño de las alianzas B2B de Skeelo. Serás la persona responsable de los procesos, cronogramas e indicadores, transformando la planificación estratégica en campañas ejecutadas con calidad. Tu rol será impulsar el crecimiento de los canales actuales y generar los insights necesarios para apoyar a la región.

Así será tu día a día en Skeelo:

Planificar y ejecutar campañas recurrentes con socios B2B, incluyendo la elaboración de briefings, apoyo en la estrategia y estructuración de canales, además del seguimiento de las métricas de éxito de las iniciativas.

Coordinar la planificación y ejecución del lanzamiento de nuevos socios, gestionando playbooks, cronogramas, calendarios de campañas e hitos de entrega con una visión integral del proceso.

Actuar como punto de contacto para socios SMB, construyendo relaciones sólidas y de largo plazo con aliados estratégicos.

Crear y monitorear dashboards e informes de desempeño (métricas de growth, engagement y conversión), transformando los datos en decisiones estratégicas.

Conectar a las áreas internas (Producto, Comercial, Marketing y Branding) para garantizar la alineación y consistencia de las acciones con los socios.

Documentar procesos, asegurando la visibilidad de los proyectos y cronogramas de entrega mediante herramientas de gestión.

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio, aportando inteligencia de mercado y análisis comparativos (benchmark), impulsando activamente el crecimiento del engagement a través de los socios, garantizando la recurrencia y una visión de mejora continua de las iniciativas.

Experiencia previa en Marketing B2B, alianzas estratégicas, canales, growth o marketing digital con enfoque en socios o clientes corporativos.

Experiencia con herramientas de CRM y gestión de proyectos (HubSpot, RD Station, Asana, ClickUp o equivalentes).

Capacidad para gestionar cronogramas de proyectos y lanzamientos de socios con autonomía y organización.

Comunicación proactiva y fluida con múltiples áreas.

Inglés y español avanzados, tanto para lectura y escritura como para conversación.

Y sería un gran plus si también cuentas con:

Experiencia en growth con enfoque B2B y/o gestión de canales con visión de expansión regional.

Experiencia en operaciones LATAM o proyectos de internacionalización, especialmente en la gestión de husos horarios y colaboración con equipos de cultura hispanohablante.

Familiaridad con el sector de Telecomunicaciones o empresas con una fuerte interfaz comercial y un ecosistema de socios.

Conocimiento de herramientas como Google Analytics, Power BI, Tableau o AppsFlyer.

Cuidamos muy bien de quienes construyen esta historia con nosotros

¿Y los beneficios?

Modelo de trabajo Remote First, con encuentros presenciales durante el año en São Paulo, con toda la logística cubierta por la empresa.

Bono anual por encima del promedio del mercado.

Días festivos locales, respetando la cultura de cada país.

Horarios flexibles, con hasta 2 horas de flexibilidad al inicio o final del día.

Programas de desarrollo: Ruta de Carrera, Universidad Skeelo y reconocimientos internos.

Día libre durante el mes de tu cumpleaños.

Licencia de maternidad y paternidad según la legislación local.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

The Business Systems Analyst is the design authority for Salesforce-based solutions across Illumina’s Commercial and Services organizations. This role bridges business intent and technical execution; translating business strategy, stakeholder needs, and product roadmaps into robust, scalable solution designs that the engineering team builds and delivers.

You will work upstream of delivery; partnering with Product Owners to shape roadmaps, evaluating platform capabilities, and producing solution designs that account for Salesforce core, ServiceMax, Conga CPQ, Conga CLM, Data Cloud (Data 360), Agentforce, and enterprise integrations. Software Engineers, Test Automation Engineers (TAEs), and Technical Architects execute delivery. The Business Systems Analyst connects these activities ensuring what gets built is the right solution, designed for scale, and aligned to Illumina’s technology strategy.

Your designs increasingly serve a second audience: the AI agents the engineering team uses to build. In an AI-augmented, spec-driven delivery model, a precise, testable, well-decomposed solution design is the specification that grounds reliable AI implementation, so the clarity of your designs, acceptance criteria, and data contracts now creates even more leverage. About Apertera

Apertera is leading the evolution of language solutions for high-stakes content. We partner with enterprises as an extension of their teams, combining professional expertise with Adaptive AI technology that is continuously refined by client context.

For more than twenty years, Apertera has set the bar for legal, financial, and regulatory translation, serving the most rigorous buyers, including over 75% of major national Canadian law firms, all major banks, and leading securities regulators.

Apertera is Canadian-owned, ISO 17100 and SOC 2 certified.

Our Core Values

Innovation

Dedication

Fanatical commitment to quality and service

Resourcefulness

Collaboration

About The Role

This is a role for someone who likes turning ideas into action. You’ll help launch campaigns, test new growth channels, support account-based marketing, improve how buyers move through our website, and find new ways to generate qualified demand. You won’t be doing it alone. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, Content, Design, and Web/MarTech, with plenty of opportunity to bring ideas forward and see their impact.

What You’ll Do

Plan and execute campaigns that generate qualified leads and business opportunities.

Build and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.

Support ABM programs through target-Account research, buyer signals, and more personalized campaigns.

Improve email campaigns for subscribers, past leads, and previous clients.

Help build referral and partner growth programs, including client referral initiatives.

Conduct keyword research and strengthen our organic search presence.

Explore how Apertera can improve visibility across AI-powered search, including AEO and GEO.

Review website performance and improve landing pages, forms, CTAs, and conversion paths.

Test new audiences, messaging, offers, and channels.

Track performance from lead through opportunity and revenue, and help us understand what to scale, improve, or stop.

What You Bring

You have 3 to 5 years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in SaaS, technology, or another B2B environment.

Experience in legal, financial services, securities, or another regulated industry is an asset, but not required.

We’re looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, comfortable getting into the details, and excited by the opportunity to build.

You should have experience with

Google Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads

B2B campaign execution

SEO and keyword research

Landing pages and conversion paths

Email marketing and nurture campaigns

Marketing analytics and funnel performance

CRM and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot

Connecting Marketing activity to qualified leads, pipeline, or revenue

Testing new ideas and using the results to improve performance

Using AI tools to make research, analysis, or campaign execution more efficient

Experience with ABM, target-account campaigns, referral programs, or website conversion is a strong asset.

Benefits & Perks

Remote Health Insurance(covered 100% by Apertera for you)

Your Birthday Off: We celebrate your special day!

6 Personal/Sick Days: Take the time you need for your health or life’s unexpected moments.

Equipped to Succeed: We provide the essential technology and equipment you need to work comfortably and effectively, from laptops and monitors to keyboards, mice, and headsets.

Work remotely

Learn and Grow With Us: Build skills, explore new interests, and take your career further with role-specific training, in-house learning opportunities, and access to thousands of courses from leading universities and companies through our learning partner.

AI & Innovation: Get access to AI tools and resources that empower you to work more efficiently, explore new ideas, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving world.

Supportive & Collaborative Team Culture: Work alongside team members who genuinely have your back

description:
Acerca de PayJoy




 




PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible.




 




 




Acerca del rol




You'll own the technology behind how PayJoy reaches customers in collections, and turn it from something we maintain into something that drives results. That stack includes Customer.io, our data pipelines, external data (EDC) integrations and a growing set of AI vendors.




Your work will be visible and measurable. Better segmentation, smarter automation and clear vendor testing will lift recovery in every market while cutting manual work and cost per contact. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building, testing and seeing their changes move real numbers.




Key Responsibilities







Run Customer.io for collections. Build and monitor workflows, messaging sequences and treatment triggers. Fix configuration issues, data mismatches and workflow failures so campaigns keep performing in every market


Automate what's still manual. Design treatment triggers, escalation logic and contact-sequencing rules. Spot manual processes that can be automated, and document every setup so the team can rely on it


Keep the data flowing. Build and maintain SQL/Python pipelines that feed customer and account data into Customer.io. Watch data quality and fix failures before they hit campaigns, working with our Data Analyst and Engineering


Connect external data. Set up and maintain EDC and third-party data integrations so new sources are validated and ready to use. Keep integration workflows and data dictionaries up to date


Test and scale AI tools. Pilot new collections tools such as conversational AI and smart contact prioritization. Measure each vendor against a control group on recovery, cost and ROI, then double down on what works


























Qualifications


We're hiring for skills and potential. If you meet most of these points, we'd like to hear from you.





1–2 years of experience in a data, CRM, marketing-automation or operations role


Hands-on use of Customer.io or a similar platform (Braze, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable or similar)


Working SQL: you can write queries to pull, join and check data on your own


Experience with workflow-automation tools


Understanding of A/B tests or treatment-vs-control experiments and how to read their results


Care for data quality: you notice when numbers don't add up and dig in


Comfort learning and setting up new tools with little supervision


Clear writing and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical teams


Advanced English and a bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience




Bonus points


None of these are required. We'll help you learn them.





Python for data pipelines or scripting


API integrations with external data sources or third-party providers


Collections or credit operations experience, especially across LatAm, South Africa or the Philippines (treatment strategies, days-past-due segmentation, agency assignment)


Databricks, Snowflake, Infobip or similar messaging gateways


Customer data platform (CDP) concepts and multi-channel contact strategy


Evaluating AI/ML vendors


Spanish, Portuguese or another language spoken in our markets









Benefits



100% Company-funded Health and dental and vision discount plan for employees and immediate family members


Life insurance


Phone finance, Headphone, home office equipment and wellness perks


30 days of Christmas bonus


20 days paid Vacation


50% Vacation premium 


13% Saving funds 


$2,000 MXN monthly grocery coupons


$2,000 USD annual Co-working Travel perk


$2,000 USD annual Professional Development perk


Catered lunches












Principios de PayJoy




 




En PayJoy estamos orgullosos de ser un empleador que promueve la igualdad de oportunidades. Damos la bienvenida y alentamos la inclusión de personas de todos los orígenes. No discriminamos por raza, religión, color, origen nacional, género (incluido el embarazo, parto o condiciones médicas relacionadas), orientación sexual, identidad de género, expresión de género, edad, estatus como veterano protegido, condición de discapacidad o cualquier otra característica legalmente protegida.
